title: The Morning Digest: October 28, 2026
dek: Tuesday's settles were Brent Dec26 $113.88 (down $1.93) and WTI Dec26 $99.90 (down $1.86), a two day pullback of $2.84 and $3.37 from Friday. Asia reversed most of it overnight, Brent $115.47 and WTI $101.33 at 0435 GMT (Reuters, Oct 28), after the Houthis claimed a missile hit on Ras Tanura, Saudi Arabia's biggest refinery; Saudi authorities did not immediately confirm, and a single unnamed source said Saudi Arabia had contained a fire near the export terminal. The private survey drew 2.031 Mbbl for the week ending Oct 23 against a survey poll at essentially flat, ahead of today's EIA report. December WCS widened a third day to -$31.00 (ICE TMW settle, Oct 27) on only 2 lots, while January widened on traded volume and the traded December export spread narrowed to +$7.57. The diesel crack fell to $92.35. Joliet's reformer has finished restarting.
